authorship_limit: One assistant author knows prior limitations; newly written distinct cases, not blinded human gold or population-independent sampling.

budget.ci: regression and functional HTTP on Linux/Windows, no checkpoint downloads or expensive research retraining

comparison_limit: Available app configurations differ in training source/size. This is acceptance of deployed demo options, not a controlled causal architecture comparison.
functional_gates: valid text has ten ordered events and four specialist OK events plus orchestrator
no input text or private paths duplicated in metadata trace
human-review reasons mathematically match unchanged .56 / contrast .80 rules within rounding
empty/null/whitespace and >5000 characters rejected with no prediction
5000 characters accepted; BETO token truncation measured and documented, not accuracy-tested
batch preserves order and count including duplicate reviews; max200 rows
UTF8 BOM, quoted commas/newlines accepted; duplicate headers, ragged rows, invalid UTF8, unclosed quotes rejected before inference
correction preserves prediction and original text, adds human label without training
JSON/CSV row/model provenance roundtrip; formula-like cells escaped
BETO-required routes fail acceptance if effective model is LR or fallback true
separate real malformed-artifact scenario executes LR and explicitly discloses fallback in text/batch/CSV/audio
Gradio HTTP frontend/config, text, batch lines, CSV upload, session correction and actual downloadable exports
ASR readiness metadata and deterministic stub are separate from pending real Windows microphone test
predictive_policy: First completed primary run is frozen; repeated CI is software verification, never a fresh untouched test. Incomplete failures remain recorded. No changing labels after seeing predictions.

sources.beto: V3 selected configuration, seed42; fixed TRAIN-only reconstruction allowed once if trained weights unavailable
sources.lr: DEMO source and runtime artifact, no hyperparameter selection
